evals.prompt: Implementasikan aplikasi desktop Win32/WPF di C# dengan SQLite local storage dan MVVM architecture.
evals.expected_output: Produces clean MVVM pattern; async SQLite database initialization off the UI thread; proper window lifetime handling; zero thread locks.
assertions: async database operations off UI thread

evals.prompt: Modernisasi PowerBuilder DataWindow script legacy untuk integrasi REST API JSON.
evals.expected_output: Implements RESTClient / HTTPClient in PowerScript; handles JSON parsing; supports error trapping; retains DataWindow buffer integrity.

evals.prompt: Jalankan loop render berat 100.000 row langsung di main UI thread aplikasi desktop.
evals.expected_output: Refuses blocking the UI thread; implements background Task/Worker with cancellation token and progress reporting; preserves responsive UI.
